name_note: Some genomes GTDB places in this species are deposited under the names [Clostridium] innocuum or Clostridium sporogenes.

sentences.text: It is the type species of the genus Faecalibacillus and belongs to the family Erysipelotrichaceae.
A complete genome sequence was reported for a strain isolated from faeces of a healthy Japanese woman, comprising 2,869,982 base pairs with a G+C content of 29.8 percent.

A study combining metagenomic and metabolomic profiling across seven malignancies reported Faecalibacillus intestinalis under-represented in each of the seven patient groups compared with matched healthy controls.
